$comment: Scrape scope (README 'Scrape scope'; docs/BUILD-SOURCING.md). Platforms and tiers need no code changes; each platform has its own platform host and shares its regional host's budget (KR+JP1 asia, EUW1/EUN1/TR1/RU/ME1 europe, NA1/BR1/LA1/LA2 americas, OC1/SG2/TW2/VN2 sea), so platforms in different regions add throughput. Non-apex tiers are paged per division, capped by maxLeaguePagesPerDivision (205 players per page): Diamond I is "tiers": [..., "DIAMOND"] with "divisions": ["I"]. pilotClasses: whose histories are scanned (otp: Irelia #1 with otpMinMasteryPoints; main: mainMinMasteryPoints among the top masteryTopCount), and only while they play Irelia this patch. harvestIrelias stores other players' top/mid Irelia games found in fetched matches. buildSources: which sources feed today's lane builds (otp, main, harvested; your own games never do). historyWindow 'patch' reads every match id of the current patch (up to maxMatchesPerPilot); 'newest' reads the matchIdsPerPlayer newest, as before. hotfixes: [{"patch": "16.19", "date": "2026-09-26T18:00:00Z", "note": "Irelia Q hotfix"}] for hotfixes that keep the build number (draft model: games before one count half). Draft-adjusted builds (docs/BUILD-SOURCING.md §9): draftSources (weighted otp 1, main 0.8, harvested 0.6), regionWeights {"NA1": 0.5}, ownRegionBoost for your own platform, patchWeights {"16.18": 0.5} overriding the Data Dragon diff.
